title: 第15章 大意了没有闪第16章 小雅姐的心病
slug: 灵气复苏我有个吞噬系统
content_zh:
“你天赋很不错，两天的时间竟然拥有了通脉境四段的修为，比起金澜城里的天骄也不差了。”
宋师姐开口道。
“我这就很不错了么？你们年纪跟我差不多，却都是道灵境强者了。”
丘凌风疑惑的道。
“你难道就不考虑修炼资源么？”
宋师姐笑着道，
“别把金澜城的众人想象的太强了，想要达到道灵境，其实很简单，只要你修炼的足够刻苦。”
“简单？”
丘凌风却不信。
如果道灵境真的那么简单能达到的话，那为什么会有那么多人终其一生都无法触碰到门槛？
嗯……
一开口就是老凡尔赛了！
“对你来说，的确比常人简单许多。”
宋师姐点头道。
“呐，师弟，你给我记住啊，后天你可千万别去南斗书院。”
紫晓灵打断了宋师姐，插嘴道。
“为什么？”
丘凌风疑惑的道。
“别问为什么，你前天才成为武者，应该还没有修炼武技之类的，师姐给你一门武技，你到时候跟我们回太玄剑院就可以了。”
紫晓灵眼睛转了转，从怀里掏出一本泛黄的秘籍，塞到了丘凌风手里，说道。

“额……好吧。”
丘凌风看着手里还带着少女温度的秘籍，点头道。
看来成为天骄的待遇也不错嘛，竟然能被太玄剑院的人抢着要。
刚见面就送了一门武技。
丘凌风正愁没有有效的攻击手段呢。
“师姐，你们先跟校长去宿舍吧，我想跟这个师弟先在这个村子里玩玩？”
紫晓灵抱着宋师姐的手臂，撒娇道。
“晓灵，绝对不行，你要是遇到危险该怎么办？”
李长空身边的那个青年脸色一变，提醒道。
“我可是道灵第一境的武者，没事的啦。”
紫晓灵开口道。
“不行，晓灵你现在不能擅自脱队。”
宋师姐开口拒绝道。
“我们后天再见吧，先在此别过了。”
content_en:
"Your talent is very good. In two days, you have reached the fourth level of Tongmai Realm. You are no worse than the geniuses in Jinlan City."
Senior Sister Song said.
"Am I very good now? You are about the same age as me, but you are all powerful in the Taoist realm."
Qiu Lingfeng said doubtfully.
"Don't you consider training resources?"
Senior Sister Song smiled and said,
"Don't think that everyone in Jinlan City is too strong. It's actually very simple to reach the Dao Spirit Realm, as long as you practice hard enough."
"Easy?"
Qiu Lingfeng didn't believe it.
If the Taoist realm is really that easy to reach, then why are so many people unable to reach the threshold throughout their lives?
Hmm...
As soon as I opened my mouth, it was old Versailles!
"For you, it is indeed much simpler than ordinary people."
Senior Sister Song nodded.
"Hey, junior brother, remember this. You must not go to Nandou Academy the day after tomorrow."
Zi Xiaoling interrupted Senior Sister Song and interjected.
"Why?"
Qiu Lingfeng said doubtfully.
"Don't ask why. You just became a warrior the day before yesterday. You probably haven't practiced any martial arts yet. Senior sister will give you a martial arts. You can just follow us back to Taixuan Sword Academy."
Zi Xiaoling rolled her eyes, took out a yellowing secret book from her arms, stuffed it into Qiu Lingfeng's hand, and said.
"Uh...okay."
Qiu Lingfeng looked at the secret book with the girl's warmth in his hand and nodded.
It seems that the benefits of becoming a genius are not bad, and people from Taixuan Sword Academy can actually get them.
As soon as we met, I was given a martial arts skill.
Qiu Lingfeng was worried that he had no effective means of attack.
"Senior sister, you go to the dormitory with the principal first. I want to play with this junior brother in this village first?"
Zi Xiaoling hugged Senior Sister Song's arm and said coquettishly.
"Xiao Ling, absolutely not, what should you do if you are in danger?"
The young man next to Li Changkong changed his expression and reminded him.
"I'm a warrior in the first level of Dao Ling. It'll be fine."
Zi Xiaoling said.
"No, Xiaoling, you can't leave the team without permission now."
Senior Sister Song refused.
"Let's see you the day after tomorrow. Let's say goodbye here first."
